answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops sybil swarms. Each work slot needs a 20-credit deposit, burned if its holder is idle or fake; honest work returns it slowly, like a glacier releasing meltwater over 20 epochs. At demand's nadir, empty slots cost nothing, so one honest agent pays 20 once and keeps every reward. The fee schedule is a flat mesa: no bulk discount, so a faker filling 1,000 slots burns 20,000 credits up front, lost when audits strike.
